You are a hostile reviewer about to bet real money on this launch plan. Evidence below: the mainnet runbook and the current next-sitting register for a TON testnet-proven consensus-settlement economy (3 cells, reputation on-chain, PR #1 unmerged upstream). Attack it: (1) the kill-vectors - what most likely kills a mainnet launch of an unverified-contract settlement rail run by one operator, (2) the sequencing - is deploy-before-GB-review right or wrong, (3) the one missing precondition nobody listed. Contract: max 8 bullets, each = (threat, why it kills, concrete mitigation), then ONE verdict line: LAUNCH-READY or HOLD plus the single highest-leverage next action. No em-dashes. Mark UNVERIFIED where the evidence cannot answer.

=== EVIDENCE 1: DEPLOY_MAINNET.md ===
# MAINNET RUN - the real-TON ladder, rung 1 (staged 2026-10-13, GO: operator)

## What is staged

- Fresh mainnet keys (gen-mainnet-wallet.js, key-law hardened: mnemonic goes
  straight to machine-local .env, never printed; regenerate-refusal built in):
  - MAINNET_DEPLOYER_ADDRESS:  EQDLZt7OU6mFsUq96WfdexSXgGHOQPpsQPScAa6ukT3yTsgG
  - MAINNET_MASTER_FLOAT_ADDRESS: EQBVBkIqqwVJfI_hs_G-TcKEeQkAp3k3rgpwhBOL6YqxZFLT
- Greed law LIVE in tools/gstd_drain.py: --cap-ton 10 (default) refuses a master
  above the cap ("return excess before earning"); --floor-ton 1 (default) refuses
  below the floor - the master must always sit inside [1, 10] TON, outside the
  SendIgnoreErrors silent-drop band (relay-skip root cause, closed 2026-10-13).
- The contracts to deploy: PR #1 versions (bonus opcode fixed, baseRate default,
  gas margin 0.3 for cold-worker deploys, reputation organ, pool speak-our-dialect
  transfer).

## The one thing only the operator can do

Fund the deployer: send ~5 TON on TON mainnet to
EQDLZt7OU6mFsUq96WfdexSXgGHOQPpsQPScAa6ukT3yTsgG
(2 TON deployment fees + 3 TON initial master float). Real money, real loss
risk, bounded by the greed law: the mainnet master never holds more than 10 TON.

## Fire sequence (next sitting, after funding)

1. Deploy GSTDJetton (mainnet endpoint, TON_NETWORK=mainnet) - the token the
   flotilla earns.
2. Deploy SettlementMaster (PR #1 tact source) wired to that jetton + the float
   wallet as pool. Verify getters: get_market_data, worker reputation map.
3. Fund the master with 3 TON from the deployer (bounce:false law).
4. Flip the drain endpoint to mainnet.toncenter.com, CELLS unchanged
   (desktop/bob/t90 ollama doors are network-agnostic).
5. First settle: ONE battery, one settle, verify on the worker jetton wallet's
   transaction LIST per the read-lag law, then loop.

## Preconditions already banked

- Relay-skip: ROOT-CAUSED (SendIgnoreErrors silent drop under low master
  balance; skips cluster in the low-balance band). The greed law keeps the
  master out of that band; the upstream fix (checked send / bonus-deferred
  event) is a PR to file with GB.
- 50+ clean testnet cycles banked; the loop is identical, only endpoint + keys
  change.
- NEVER reuse testnet mnemonics on mainnet. The testnet keys retire forever.

=== EVIDENCE 2: NEXT_SITTING.md ===
# GSTD DRAIN - NEXT SITTING REGISTER (filed 2026-10-13)

## 1. Relay-skip anomaly (OPEN, receipted 10/12)

Intermittent bonus-relay skip: settle A at 01:51:20Z showed out 3, settle B at
02:02:13Z showed out 4, identical inputs. The one genuine contract question for
GB. Reproduce with trace-v6-settles.ts across N settles before asking.

## 2. Task-bank co-evolution law (NEW, from DUET + this paper)

Two independent papers force the same design item:

- DUET (dair_ai drop 3): update the grader alongside the agent - the agent's
  failure modes change as it improves.
- Persistent Memory in Multi-Agent LLM Inference (arXiv:2610.07782): the null is
  STRUCTURAL on single-question benchmarks - stored traces have nothing
  informative to retrieve when every condition resets them.

Design item: the battery's task bank must (a) rotate/regenerate tasks as
reputation climbs (the council of five must not become the old king's scales),
and (b) add LONGITUDINAL tasks - sequences where run N's trace is informative
for run N+1 - because that is the only shape in which the estate's memory tier
(mycelium, rib_bus, residue) is measurable at all. A memory-ablation arm on
longitudinal tasks, preregistered, would give the mycelial thesis its first
honest accuracy measurement. Until then: the estate claims memory as continuity,
never as per-task accuracy lift.

## 3. Loop standing (operator decision)

The earn loop is window-driven; overnight it idled 14.5h. A cron (MagGstdDrain,
like MagCensusPatrolDaily) makes it standing. Master TON 1.73 supports it.

## Closed this sitting (2026-10-13 morning)

- T90 jetton wallet: DEPLOYED, 50 GSTD held, on-chain rep 1 (was the pending item).
- 08:24Z settle: LANDED - desktop JW at 100,000,325, exactly the claimed 325.
- Drain fired live: desktop STRUCTURE +25 + settle rc 0; bob NOISE-CLASS refused.

## UPDATE 2026-10-13: relay-skip ROOT-CAUSED (was item 1) - CLOSED

The decoder's 60-tx sweep shows the skips are NOT random: every out-3 settle
(03:20, 04:18, 04:34, 10:30, 11:20) sits in the master's low-balance band, and
after the 11:27 2.0 TON top-up nothing skips again. Mechanism, read from
SettlementMaster.tact:208-231: the bonus relay sends with mode SendIgnoreErrors -
when the master's remaining balance cannot cover the 0.3 TON send, the message
silently no-ops. "Identical inputs" was the wrong premise: input messages were
identical, the governing state (balance) differed. Deterministic after all.

Cures: (1) PR #1 client-side fresh-read gate (shipped), (2) greed law
[floor 1, cap 10] TON now LIVE in tools/gstd_drain.py (defaults), (3) upstream
PR for GB: replace SendIgnoreErrors on the bonus send with a checked branch that
emits a bonus-deferred event (file with the PR #1 review).
